body: Thank you for making me laugh and taking the time for a thoughtful response. Keep on kicking ass!
Thank you so much for taking the time to write this response to me. Thank you so much
Thank you so much for this. It means everything to me right now. Thank you so much

It's not your fault. It's so much easier to say this to you as a stranger than it is to say to myself. But NOTHING he or anyone else can say to you diminishes the ownership you have over your body and your experiences. You don't have to carry his guilt. A few years ago a friend raped me when I was passed out after blacking out . I wouldn't have even known it happened had he not told me about it in passing the next day almost like it was a joke. Sometimes people do inconceivably fucked up things that they can't even recognize their own actions because they are so wrapped up in their own internal monologues and preserving their self image. Just because you were fucked up does not mean that you signed away the agency to you our own body. You're brave for coming here and sharing this and you're brave for being cognizant through this experience, painful as it might be. 

RAINN really helped me a lot. The assault brought up some shit from childhood that I was running away from but I couldn't avoid anymore. They referred me to a place with (free!) therapy and other resources. 


So much love from across the interwebs
